l.i: Sed altitudine gratiæ & iudicij diuini obturbata ratio nihil hic intentatum relinquit, exemplo Pelagianorum veterum & recentium: quorum illos Augustinus olim, hos Lutherus, solidissime confutarunt. Viderint igitur qui Lutherani audire volunt, & contra Lutherum & veritatem ipsam, cum Pelagianis sentiunt. Sed finem facio, Deumque oro, ut sub Cels. vestra pacis, literarum & pietatis studia semper floreant. Amen. Heidelbergæ xij. Mart. Anno MDXCII.

page.notes: The marginal note reads "De seruo arb. & alibi," with "De" and "arb." in bold type. The year is printed as "Anno MDXCII" in the old reversed-C form. The ornament is a woodcut and is not transcribed. Some words in the scan are faint and were read with reasonable confidence.
